name: Forge synthetic quiet-development 10000
origin: Original deterministic generator; no external games, books or evaluation weights.
selection: Legal quiet moves, no queens or rook moves; minor pieces develop from their home rank; castling allowed; final move is a pawn move. Exclude checked/terminal final positions. No evaluator screening.
freeze: Generated using unchanged v5.7.0 core before the SEE implementation; regenerated byte-identically using the candidate under ASan/UBSan.
history: Last move is irreversible and halfmove clock is zero, so the EPD start loses no relevant reversible repetition history.
independent_validation: All 120000 moves checked with external MIT chess-library 0.9.4 bundled in pinned Fastchess CI artifact.
limitations: Synthetic openings are not a representative human opening distribution. General strength claims require independent replication on another license-verified fixed corpus and a longer time control.
